import os

from openai import Client

client = Client(
    api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"),
)

result = client.beta.threads.update("thread_id", tool_resources={"code_interpreter": {"file_ids": ["string"]}, "file_search": {"vector_store_ids": ["string"]}}, metadata={"key": "string"})
print(result)

fields.name: id
fields.description: The identifier, which can be referenced in API endpoints.

fields.name: object
fields.description: The object type, which is always `thread`.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) for when the thread was created.
